en: Alright, maintenance is finished.
Thanks.
There we go...
Yeah. It feels right.
Of course it does! After all, it's\na masterpiece created by me!
Yes, yes. I'm grateful, and I\nthink it's amazing.

Hey! You're not putting any
heart into it! Don't you have
any of that "Wow, you're
incredible!" feeling for me?!

This "Twin Blade" has saved my
life many times, and it has
allowed me to save many
others.
Right now, this is the weapon\nthat fits my hand best.
That should be enough, right?
Well... I guess I'll give you a\npassing grade for now!

So, don't ever do anything that
reckless again. No one but
Welch can handle these twin
blades.
I know, I know.

You, Eve and the others, and
even Sister Eslyn gave me
such a hard time about it that
I'm not doing anything that
crazy on my own anymore.
Sister Eslyn too?
She stopped by the shop this\nmorning.
Huh? I didn't hear anything\nabout that.
Sister Eslyn is always very\nconsiderate about those\nthings.

She told me that if I pushed
myself too far and got hurt, Eu
would be heartbroken, so I
absolutely must not be
reckless.
I-I wouldn't be heartbroken!
Well... I might panic a little.

Yeah, yeah. Thanks. Anyway,
I've got a lot to prepare at the
shop today, so can we wrap
this up?
Yeah, sorry to keep you.

You're heading to the Royal
Capital with those weird
traveling performers, right?
Are you leaving today?

I plan to leave tomorrow
morning. It's been a few days
since the blockade was lifted,
so logistics are back to normal.
We've gathered enough food
and supplies.
I-I see. Well, let me know when\nyou're heading out. I'll come\nsee you off.
Really? You don't have to go\nthrough the trouble.

I'm well aware that I've been a
nuisance to you and those
people, Eu. This is the least I
can do.
Well, don't worry. I'll make sure\nto come back this time too.
I'm not worried. There's no\nreason to be.
Jeez, how cold.

Oh? What's this? Did you
actually think I'd burst into
tears and beg you not to go,
Eu?
See ya. Thanks for everything.
...Sigh, and he's gone. Well, I\nguess that's just like Eu.
...Now then.
<font color=blue>Eslyn</font> ...Please, take good care\nof him. I apologize for visiting\nso early in the morning.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Yes... thank you for coming\nall this way.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Euwin's big sister... she\nwas so beautiful.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> I had thought that the
Rakstar family of lords
contained nothing but
cold-blooded individuals
besides Euwin...
It is likely because of that\nsister that Euwin is able to act\nso freely.

<font color=blue>Eve</font> Phew, I was so nervous. I
never expected Euwin's sister
to come and greet us
personally.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Despite being a noble,
she did not doubt us strangers
and prayed for our safe
travels. We cannot let such
kindness go to waste.

<font color=blue>Eve</font> You're right. She even
covered our lodging expenses
while we were in Carlone. We'll
really have to make sure Euwin
thanks her properly once this
is all over.
Speak of the devil, Ewin Laxter\nis approaching.
You're right. Hey! Euwin's sis...
He's running toward us with a\nlot of momentum...
R-RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!!
W-what in the world is\nhappening!?
What's wrong, Euwin!? Don't tell\nme there's a Beast in the city!
There's no time to explain!\nEveryone, run! Run for the East\nGate!
Just tell us what's going on!!
A-Alright, if we can just make it\nthis far...
*Pant*... *pant*... W-what on\nearth was that...
Big brother Euwin, you look\npale. Are you okay?

I-I'm fine. Let's just get through
the city walls and onto the
highway as fast as we can.
Once we pass the checkpoint...
...Tika, someone is approaching\nat high speed.
E-everyone, something's\ncoming...
Gah!? A-already!?
W-what is that!?
N-no way, is that...!?
G-guard, hurry! Get us out of\nhere! What? Wait your turn!?
This is no time for that! We\nhave to get out now, or\nelse―waaaaaah!!

...Take that, you little brat!!
You're a hundred years too
early to try and run away from
me!!
Big sister Welch!?
Whoa!!
Oops, sorry sorry! I bumped\ninto you!
Bumped into is an\nunderstatement!
What is with all that luggage!?
What do you mean? It's for my\ntravel preparations, obviously!!
Travel preparations... wait, you\ndon't mean you're coming with\nus!?
What else would I be doing in a\nsituation like this!
Ugh... she should have just\ncome along quietly without\nsaying anything...!
And what exactly do you plan\nto do by following us!

Isn't it obvious? I'm going to
thoroughly research all your
strange, wonderful, and
mysterious quirks!
Especially Verda's "Light Arrow"\nand all those lovely things\nabout Tika... Hehe, hehehe!
Big sister Welch is a little\nscary...
Alert mode... Alert mode...\nRaising defense level by one\nstage...
Welch, we aren't going to the\nroyal capital for a vacation!
I'm not saying this for fun\neither!
You're not the only one with\nthings you want to achieve,\nEu-bo!
So, looking forward to working\nwith you for a while!
W-wait, we haven't even...
...Well, why not?
...Oppose... Oppose...
Verda!? What are you saying!?
Verda!? What are you talking\nabout!

I cannot tell you what kind of
dangerous actions I might take
if I am not allowed to
accompany you.

It would be pointless to have
worked so hard to save you if
you only go and do something
reckless after we leave.
Wouldn't you agree, Euwin?
W-well, that might be true,\nbut...
Besides, I am quite interested\nin the mysterious technology\nthat Welch possesses.
...I suppose so. As they say, it's\nbetter to have company on a\njourney.
All right... if you all feel that\nstrongly about it...
In exchange, Verda and Tika,\nplease stay behind me as much\nas possible...

Exactly! Yay, thanks a bunch!
Well, since I'm coming along,
you can all just relax and leave
everything to me!

Come to think of it, what was
the name of your ship again?
I'll give it a thorough
maintenance check for you!

If we accidentally let this
person onto the ship, I feel like
every single screw would be
dismantled...
Hm? Did you say something?
...Captain, just so you know,\nthat ventriloquism act isn't\nfunny.

*Sigh*... It's getting more and
more crowded... I just hope
nothing happens on the way to
the royal capital...

Even with the "Beast of
Baschen" gone, things are still
somehow just as dangerous as
ever, huh?

The "Beast" might have driven
the wild animals out of their
natural habitats. I can see
some wolves over there.
I don't know... it feels kind of\nwrong to have to take them\ndown...
Hey, Verda, Tika!

You don't have to use little Eu
as a shield; I'm not going to do
anything weird in a situation
like this!
I don't trust you.
A-ahaha...
I... I have to protect the two of\nthem...

But honestly, I think that
hammer that shoots jets and
Euwin's glowing sword are far
more impressive.
Huh?

Indeed, indeed. If you can make
such amazing things yourself,
our weapons aren't exactly a
novelty anymore.

Amazing? You think I'm
amazing?! Ehehe, you can keep
the compliments coming, you
know!
...Sigh.
Ehehe... But you see... actually...\nabout this...
It's not exactly my own original\ndesign.
Huh?
What? Wait, Euwin, you didn't\nknow either?
This is the first I've heard of\nit...
Because I didn't tell you.

So actually, I have no idea how
this hammer or Eu's
double-blade even work.
Ahahaha!
Hey!?
Wait, both of you!? Why are\nyou looking at the Captain!?
They aren't going to explode,\nare they!?
Sorry, big brother Euwin...
Don't be so scared. I'm sure it\nwas built properly!

But if it is not the original,
does that mean there is a
master, a prototype, or
perhaps blueprints existed
from the start?
Ah... this is a problem. Verda,\nare you actually really smart?
Of course I am!
You're actually gonna say that\nyourself?!

I feel like I've seen a certain
lady somewhere calling herself
"super pretty" or something like
that?
Ahaha, you got me! You totally\ngot me!
You know... these two might\nactually be more alike than\nthey seem.
Verda, are you going to be just\nlike Welch when you grow up?
Now, jokes aside, I know I'm\njust tagging along, but there's\nsomewhere I want us to stop.
We are in a bit of a hurry,\nthough...
I know, but you guys need Eu's\nhelp, right?

I want to collect some reliable
parts so I can properly
maintain Eu's Twin Blades of
Light.
Things might get more\ncomplicated as we get closer\nto the Royal Capital,

and if Eu's weapon breaks
during a fierce battle with
some weirdo like last time,
everyone's going to be in
trouble, right?
Well, I suppose that's true...

Tika and Verda seem uneasy
about my inventions too, so I'll
let you in on a few trade
secrets.
I thought that might put your\nminds at ease.
I'm actually pretty uneasy too.

These Twin Blades have saved
my life many times, and they've
allowed me to save many

That should do it, right?\n*Strikes a pose!*
I'm regretting saying that with\nevery fiber of my being right\nnow!
Hahaha! Anyway, the place is\npretty deep inside the forest\nwe were in before.
Who knows, maybe some of\nthose "beasts" from last time\nare still hanging around?

...Captain, everyone, I'm sorry.
You can deduct this from my
reward as much as you want,
but would you mind coming
along?
I guess we have no choice... I'd\nbe worried about what's ahead\nwithout Euwin's help.
I'd rather not have a weapon\nexplode right next to me,\neither...

I cannot leave Tika in the
vicinity of something with such
a high probability of exploding!
AI Coro! Initiate transport
containment!!
Y-yeah... R-Rekoro, I'm okay, so\nplease be a little quieter...!
Then sorry, but I'm counting on\nyou! I bet everyone's going to\nbe shocked!

Come on, everything is a
learning experience! Captain, if
you stick to ventriloquism
forever, the audience will get
bored!
...Captain, sorry, I'm also really\nregretting my traveling\nperformer persona.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Phew, I'm so glad you\nguys came! I definitely would've\ndied if I were alone!

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> There were more
"Beasts" left than I expected. It
didn't feel like the Beast Witch
had returned, but there might
be more that were missed
during the subjugation.
I'll have to send a letter to my\nsister sometime...

<font color=blue>Eve</font> So, what is this "corporate
secret" of yours? We've walked
quite a distance off the main
road.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Don't worry, we're\nalmost there!

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Wolves have lived in this
forest since long ago. They
seem pretty agitated because
of Baschen's beast, so let's
finish your business quickly
before things get troublesome.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> I know, I know!

<font color=blue>Welch</font> Look, we're here! Right
here! Oh, thank goodness, it
looks like nothing happened to
this place!
<font color=blue>Eve</font> This place... there's nothing\nhere.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Hehehe, Eve, can't you\nsee what's right in front of\nyou?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Are you talking about this\npile of junk?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> No matter how I look at
it, it just looks like an illegal
dumping site for scrap
materials.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Hehehe! You lot lack\ntraining, you traveling\nperformers!
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> (...This is!)
<font color=blue>Tika</font> (Rekoro?)
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> (Strange... Could this\nreaction be...!)
Now then! What you are about\nto see involves no tricks or\nillusions!
Behold the secret lab of the\ngenius beautiful girl inventor,\nWelch Vineyard!!
What!?
Huh!?
W-what is this!?
No way!
I knew it...
Come on in, come on in! Don't\nworry, nothing's going to\nexplode!
W-what on earth is this place?!
Whoa...
See? My secret lab!
Oh my, little Euwin is\nwitnessing a maiden's secrets!\nTee-hee!
I don't recognize... a single\nthing in here.
No... this is... but... it couldn't\nbe.
Huh? No reactions? Come on,\neveryone, aren't you all a bit\ntoo shocked?
It would be unreasonable not\nto be shocked... Did you\nactually build all this?
As if!
This is... probably the "Power of\nthe Servant."
The Power of the Servant?!\nWelch, why on earth would\nyou...
Eight years ago.
Eight years ago, this thing fell\nfrom the sky.
Fell from the sky?
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Yeah... I happened to be\nat Carlone's house, looking out\nthe window.
Then, a sparkling light fell\nstraight from the sky into this\nforest.
At the time, the whole town\nwas buzzing with rumors that\nthe Holy War was almost over...

So, being the innocent and
pure little girl I was, I rushed
out of the house to find it,
thinking, "That must be the
power of a familiar!"
Because I thought my father\nmight be coming home.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Welch, big sister...?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...

<font color=blue>Welch</font> My father... he was
taken as a soldier in the Holy
War eight years ago and never
came back.

He didn't come back when my
mother got sick, or even for
her funeral. I don't know where
he's wandered off to, but he's
a pretty useless old man.
If Eu and Eslyn hadn't been\nthere back then, I might've\nended up on the streets.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> ...
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Well, my mom was still\nalive when this thing fell from\nthe sky,

but since I never doubted that
my dad would come home, I
came here and discovered this
mysterious lab.

At first, I really had no idea
what was going on, but then
something happened and I
figured out how to operate the
place.

Six years ago, when my mom
died of her illness, I had to
learn how to survive on my
own.

<font color=blue>Welch</font> My dad used to run a
general blacksmith shop.
Thanks to that, I've been on
good terms with the metal and
scrap dealers for a long time...

So, I thought I'd just sell off
some of the rare stuff in this
lab! And I actually did sell a
few things!
<font color=blue>Eve</font> I... I see...
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Then one day, I\nhappened to touch this, and\nthis thing popped out.

Weapon blueprints written in
the language of Daftine... T-this
is impossible... What on earth is
this...?
What? Is Tika doing\nventriloquism now?
Oh, no, um, I just got surprised\nand choked a little... *cough,\ncough*.
Be careful! Sickness is nothing\nto play around with.
Y-yeah...
Are these the blueprints for\nEuwin's weapon?

That's right. It's got everything
written out in detail, like which
parts to make with which
device and how to put them
together,
all accompanied by drawings\nthat look just like the real\nthing.

When I first saw this, I finally
realized that I'd been blessed
with some incredible stroke of
luck.

After that, whenever I had a
spare moment, I'd head over
there and try out different
ways to make things work, bit
by bit...

But even after six years, all I
managed to make were Eu's
sword, my hammer, and some
handy tools for the shop.
There's still so much I don't\nunderstand.
Verda, do you think you could\nfigure out how to get these\nweird devices working?
I... I'm not so sure. Everything\nhere is completely new to me...
Go ahead and tinker with them.\nIt's not like they'll wear out,\nand they won't explode.
H-hm, but will I actually\nunderstand anything...? I'm not\nvery confident.
Captain, would you... would you\nmind taking a look with me? I'm\na bit scared.
H-hm, thanks for the help...\nW-whoa, what on earth is this?

Anyway, I've decided to spend
my days here in this lab
focusing on all sorts of
research.
I'm going to make the absolute\nmost of this stroke of luck.
And... you're doing that for\nEuwin's weapon?
Well... regardless of everything,\nEu is the one person who really\nunderstands me.
Besides, I don't know what this\nplace actually is, but it's still\ntrue that it fell from the sky.

So, one day, I want to uncover
the secret of this lab and
travel to wherever it came
from.
Does that mean...?
Beyond the sky!
The logo for my shop is a\ndeclaration of that resolve!

I want to see what's beyond
the sky! And I want to be
number one! The cutest! The
richest!
Number one... uh, anyway, I'm\naiming for the very top!
Welch...
See? Pretty interesting, right?

Now, I want to mass-produce
some of the tools needed to
maintain Eu's and my weapons
here.
Can you wait just a little\nlonger?
Yes, of course...
W-Whaaaat!? What is this!?
Wait...
Yeah, yeah... Captain, are you\nsure that wasn't actually your\nreal voice?
So, Verda? See anything\ninteresting?
Verda?
Oh, u-uh, well, I still didn't quite\nunderstand it.

We're short on time, so could
you please focus on making
the weapon parts for Welch
and Euwin for now?

Got it, got it. I've got some
other things I want to make
too, so give me a little more
time!
How are Euwin and Welch\ndoing?

They are fine. They're likely
adjusting the double blades; I
sense no sign of them leaving
the back of the lab.
I see... well then...
Rekoro & Coro: What on earth\nis this!? "What on earth is\nthis?!"
Shh! H-hey, you two are being\ntoo loud!
I-is it really that shocking!?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> There is no mistake.
This is clearly the work of an
advanced civilization...
Furthermore, if my assessment
is correct...
Their level of civilization is\nlikely even more advanced than\nthat of our own ship.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> R-really?!
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "It's frustrating, but I\nbelieve it's true..."
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> It's possible they are\neven more advanced than\nDaftine, where Tika lived.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I couldn't examine it too\nclosely out of consideration for\nWelch, but

The energy conversion
efficiency of the Replicator is
clearly not from the modern
era.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> However, there is
something strange. The
language displayed was the
current language of this planet.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What's so strange about\nthat?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> It may be late to
mention, but the language of
this land is the same as that of
Daftine, Tika's homeland.

The same applies to the
characters used in Carlone, as
well as the speech of Ewin
Laxter and Welch Vineyard.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Me, Eve, and the\nCaptain all communicate\nthrough translators, but...
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Yeah, I'm just speaking\nnormally.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Based on the usage of
characters and language, the
progression of the Holy War,
and the names of key figures
in the Kingdom of Rubarika,

I conclude that our current
situation is from an era
approximately two hundred
years before the time Tika
lived in.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Two hundred years...?\nYou mean we've gone back in\ntime?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Wait, Rekoro, does that\nmean...
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> That's right. Tika and I\nhave traveled through time.
This is Daftine, but from a time\nfar in the past compared to\nthe Daftine Tika lived in.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "I support that theory. It's\nthe most plausible explanation\nfor our current situation.
However, that still leaves\nseveral questions regarding\nthis planet...

For instance, who exactly sent
Welch's lab here, and why is it
set to the language of this
era...?"
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Aye. The Levarance\narmy was only expelled from\nthis sector in the present day.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> If Tika came from two
hundred years in the future,
then I don't understand why a
general of the Rubarika
Kingdom living in the present is
searching for her by name.
That armored man from before\nalso seemed to know Tika from\nthe start. And...

We can't just ignore that
"Beast Witch" who uses the
same summoning crest arts as
Eve.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Karlyn... was that her\nname? That Beast Witch...

<font color=blue>Verda</font> She belongs to a nation
enemy to Rubarika. It'll be
difficult to arrange a meeting
on our own terms.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "I suspect she'll just\nattack us the moment we\nmeet..."
<font color=blue>Tika</font> That lady... she had a tail,\ndidn't she?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> 『I believe she belongs to\na race called the Foxtail.

They are skilled in Symbology,
and among humanoid races,
their average lifespan is
slightly longer.
Rekoro, are there any Foxtails\nin Daftine...?』

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> They are a minority
living throughout Baschen, but
there should be almost none in
Rubarika.

<font color=blue>Tika</font> That was my first time
seeing one. I'd heard stories
about people with tails, but I
didn't know that lady was one
of them.
You're taking this quite calmly,\nTika.
Yeah... I mean, it's not like I\ncouldn't imagine it.
Everything is so unfamiliar, but\nthere are so many things I\nstudied at school,

or things I heard in stories
from my grandpa and grandma,
and we can even understand
each other...
I kind of felt like I'd traveled\nback in time.
Tika...
I never imagined that would\nactually happen to me.
But in stories, time travel isn't\nthat unusual, right?

Just like the heroes in those
stories, I'm on a mysterious
adventure, being helped by
Rekoro and the Captain...
That's why... I...
Sister Verda...
I can go back, right...? I can go\nback to Daftine... right?
It is not a matter of whether\nyou can! You shall return!
Return...?

I once found myself trapped in
a despair so deep and terrible
that I thought the clouds would
never clear.
But I did not give up. No\nmatter how sad or painful it\nwas, I refused to surrender.
And that is how... I grasped a\nmiracle.
...Sister... Verda...
Tika. I... we promise that we will\nmake a miracle happen.
So, stop crying now. We will\nnever abandon you, Tika.

According to my grandfather's
last will, I must reduce the
total amount of tears in the
universe...
So... no more crying.
...Ugh... waaaah... waaaaaah...!
Oh... yeah, sorry. I just felt a bit\npathetic.
Verda and Tika are working so\nhard despite being so small,
yet I let myself get shaken just\nbecause the Beast Witch had\nthe same power as I do...
I can't do this. At this rate, I\ncan't even treat them like\nchildren.
The cheerful Eve is the best.
Don't push yourself too hard.
Should I treat you like a child?
Hehe, thanks. It's not like I was\nreally depressed.

It's just... while I still don't
understand the true nature of
my own power, the Beast Witch
seemed to use hers so freely.
That's why I got rattled.

I'll be fine. I'll worry and I'll think
about it, but I'll never stop
moving forward. After all, Tika
is the most important thing
right now.
I don't think... I'm pushing\nmyself... but if anything, I'm just\nspinning my wheels.
Come to think of it, I don't\nactually have a goal.

The memory loss I mentioned
at first was a lie, but I really
have no idea where I came
from or why I can use
Symbology...

I don't need a goal as grand as
Verda's to reduce the Tears of
the Universe, but I'm still
shaken by the Beast Witch,
even though I haven't even
found my own footing...
Ah, what am I even talking\nabout?

...Thanks. Taking it easy, huh...
Maybe I'm managing because
you say things like that,
Captain. ...I don't even know
what I'm saying anymore.

...Just so you know, my age is
the one thing I remember. I'm
eighteen. No mistake about it.
I'm not a child anymore!

To think you still see an
eighteen-year-old as a child...
Captain, that's a very
old-fashioned way of thinking.
...Hehe, but thanks. Do you\nknow what the privilege of\nbeing a child is?

It's being able to rely on
someone unconditionally.
Maybe I'll start relying on you
for a few things?
Just kidding. Don't panic so\nmuch.

A wolf's howl? I wonder if it's
the wolves Euwin mentioned
that live in this forest. It
sounds closer than before.

Euwin and the others should be
finishing up soon. I'd like to
return to the road before it
gets dark. Let's check...
Everyone! Please be careful! A\nstrange biological reaction is\napproaching!
Huh!?

『There is only one, but it is
approaching you all at a speed
incomparable to any other
creature in this region!』
『Rekoro! I will prepare the\nteleportation for Tika!』
Euwin! Welch!
What is it!?
What's going on!?
Here it comes!?
Wh-what on earth is that!?
I've never seen a beast like\nthat before...
It was even creepier than the\nothers...
Indeed... Just to be safe...
Hm? Verda? What's wrong?\nMaybe you shouldn't get too\nclose.

...Ah, no, there was just
something on my mind. This
